name: Walmart Land
desc:
Welcome to Walmart Land, where you can run, jump, & play across 6 unique isles home to games, challenges, & exclusive items–like merch from Justice!

🚡 Fly across Serenity Isle on the zip line
🚐 Visit Food Truck Park in the Flavor Garden
⚽️ Kick the ball around on the Isle of Fun
👠 Conquer the oversized obby in the House of Style
🎛️ Mix up some beats on Electric Island
🎤 Hit the high note on the Sound Stage
